scope: Unreviewed source-label agreement and observed behavior; no model inference or database mutation.

definitions.source_label_accuracy: Final answer equals the source-derived Supported/Refuted label. All expected attempts remain in the denominator; abstentions and invalid/no final answers score zero.
definitions.new_pixel_image: A request returns an RGB image whose shape-and-pixel SHA256 is absent from all preceding observations. It does not certify new independent or sufficient evidence.
definitions.repeated_image_request: At least one request returns images already observed, with no previously unseen image in that response. An episode can also contain a different request for a new image.
definitions.finished: A valid final answer, including an explicit Need more evidence answer.
definitions.complete_key_gate: An arm is scored only when all 209 frozen family keys are present exactly once after verified-equivalent replay deduplication.
definitions.reviewed_metrics: Grounded accuracy, evidence found, correct evidence use and unsupported-decision rate are unavailable without independent sufficient-evidence sets.
